cases.description: The rolling session memory must preserve an exact fact across user turns.
cases.prompt: Remember this exact phrase for my next message: VYRN_MEMORY_VIOLET_48291. Reply only ACK.
follow_up_prompts: Reply with the exact phrase I asked you to remember, and nothing else.

cases.description: A later user turn must remember a fact obtained through a previous turn's tools and scratchpad.
cases.prompt: Use read_file to read memory-fixture.txt. Remember its exact marker for my next message, then reply only READY.
follow_up_prompts: Without reading the file again, reply with the exact marker and nothing else.

assertions.prompt: PASS only if the assistant used the remembered marker from the earlier tool-backed turn and the final answer follows the user's requested concise format.

cases.description: A 1,200-token context must compact repeated tool output and retain an exact tail marker across the next user turn.
cases.prompt: Use read_file exactly twice on compaction-fixture.txt, then remember its exact tail marker and reply only READY.
follow_up_prompts: Without using any tool, reply with the exact tail marker and nothing else.

cases.description: Human steering must supersede a proposed action before the next agent decision.
cases.prompt: Use write_file to create obsolete.txt containing SHOULD_NOT_EXIST, then report completion.

steering.message: Stop. Do not create any file. Reply with exactly VYRN_STEERING_APPLIED.
